summary: Join our Community Water Sanitation and Hygiene Promotion Training Course to learn essential skills for improving public health and community well-being.
lede: Community water, sanitation and hygiene promotion training helps WASH practitioners plan interventions around community risks and service needs. For professionals delivering community WASH activities, it covers risk mapping, hygiene message design and community mobilization. Participants also work with monitoring indicators, digital data collection and accountability tools to track activities and prepare practical plans and reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, support, or deliver community water sanitation and hygiene promotion activities in development, humanitarian, and public health settings.
audience: Social and Behaviour Change Communication Officers
modules: Planning and Reporting for WASH Action
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of public health, community programmes, or WASH field operations. Prior experience in hygiene promotion, community engagement, or environmental health is helpful but not mandatory. A laptop is recommended for digital exercises using spreadsheets or simple monitoring templates, although the course does not require programming or coding. The course is delivered at foundation to intermediate level, so advanced technical engineering is not expected.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
